record.rationale: Consumed std::set/__tree insert, red-black balancing, end/begin links, ordered iterator increment and recursive value destruction follow the pinned Emscripten SDK libc++ __tree source. Tree nodes are JS VM objects; actual DirectoryHelper string/pair specializations compare UTF16 lexicographically and copy/destroy real OUString values. No synthetic IO, allocator, native pointer or filesystem provider. This preserves consumed tree algorithms and value lifetime, not physical native node layout. Remaining STL APIs, insertion-result iterator binding, debug assertions, native ABI/OOM and whole document package/UI acceptance remain unbound or unqualified.
